canonical_definition: Consolidated annual revenue or issuer-equivalent net sales
source_policy: Direct reported value unless company mapping documents an aggregation
notes: Company-specific revenue recognition remains a comparability note

canonical_definition: Revenue less the issuer-relevant direct cost base
source_policy: Direct or project-derived only when the company mapping documents the derivation
applicability_rule: May be unavailable for platform models without a reliable cost-of-revenue definition
notes: Amazon gross profit remains project-derived in the frozen analytical release

canonical_definition: Consolidated GAAP net income attributable to the defined common equity base
source_policy: Direct reported value using the company-specific mapping
notes: Issuer attribution boundaries are checked against the manual reconciliation

canonical_definition: Fiscal-year-end consolidated liabilities under the project reconciliation boundary
source_policy: Direct or derived only when documented
notes: May be derived in the frozen analytical release when a reliable total line is absent

canonical_definition: Fiscal-year-end stockholders equity or deficit under the project boundary
applicability_rule: Required; nonpositive average equity makes ROE invalid
Required for liquidity ratios when reported
Required for liquidity ratios when reported

canonical_definition: Cash and cash equivalents excluding marketable securities unless issuer presentation requires otherwise
applicability_rule: Cash-only liquidity can understate broader liquid assets
Blank is not zero when inventory is not separately reported or not applicable

canonical_definition: Fiscal-year-end long-term borrowing excluding operating lease liabilities
source_policy: Direct or verified zero only when the filing supports it
applicability_rule: Blank when no reliable separate borrowing balance is available

canonical_definition: Fiscal-year-end current and noncurrent interest-bearing debt under the issuer reporting boundary
source_policy: Use a direct consolidated tag when available; otherwise require a documented company-level aggregation
applicability_rule: Conditional A2 probe field; not yet frozen for Q1
notes: Absence of a direct tag is an override candidate rather than evidence of zero debt

canonical_definition: Net cash provided by or used in operating activities
sign_policy: Cash inflow positive and cash outflow negative

canonical_definition: Project-defined purchases of property and equipment plus documented capitalized software where applicable
sign_policy: Store cash outflow as a positive amount
applicability_rule: Required for project free cash flow
notes: Issuer-specific software additions may require a documented manual aggregation

canonical_definition: Operating cash flow minus project capital expenditure
applicability_rule: Required and reconciled to OCF minus CapEx

canonical_definition: Fiscal-year-end common shares outstanding across relevant share classes
applicability_rule: Do not use weighted-average EPS shares
notes: May require class aggregation for dual-class issuers
